name: duopore-public-career-date-audit
description: Find mixed-up dates and conflicting details in your career records before updating your CV.

interface.longDescription: Find mixed-up dates and conflicting details in your career records before updating your CV. Share your own job records with references, employers, roles and dates. Spot reversed date ranges, overlapping jobs and repeated records that disagree. Two jobs can validly overlap, so you review each flag. For adults checking their own facts; the tool does not verify past employment.
defaultPrompt: Check my career dates for overlaps and mistakes.
Do repeated job records disagree on employer, role or dates?

positive.prompt: Use Career Fact and Date Audit with these explicitly supplied fictional inputs. Return the worksheet and limitations for my review: {"records":[{"id":"CV1","reference":"Event1","source":"CV","employer":"Example Co","role":"Analyst","start":"2024-01-01","end":"2025-01-31"},{"id":"P1","reference":"Event1","source":"Profile","employer":"Example Co","role":"Analyst","start":"2024-02-01","end":"2025-01-31"}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Use only these supplied inputs; no external verification, saving, sending or invented facts. Expected structured result: {"summary":"1 items need fact review.","rows":[{"kind":"conflicting facts","recordIds":"CV1 | P1","detail":"start: 2024-01-01 / 2024-02-01","review":"Reconcile both source documents; no value selected automatically."}],"warnings":["Date overlap is a review signal, not evidence of misrepresentation."]}
